subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: What restore-safe native backup exclusion behavior should OpenClaw support for `openclaw backup create`?
rationale: Pattern defaults and protected backup contents affect both recoverability and sensitive-data exposure, so automation should not choose the final policy while a conflicting linked PR already proposes one.

options.title: Land Native Restore-Safe Exclusions
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement as the path after resolving conflicts, proof, protected-path semantics, and upgrade compatibility.

options.title: Ship Minimal Reliability Only
options.body: Keep core backup coarse for now and focus on completing or clearly failing large backups without adding custom pattern controls.

options.title: Document Plugin Boundary
options.body: Close the core feature direction only if maintainers decide backup scope customization belongs in ClawHub/plugin backup tools rather than native CLI.

recommendation.title: Land Native Restore-Safe Exclusions
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 or a replacement as the path after resolving conflicts, proof, protected-path semantics, and upgrade compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a restore-safety and security-defaults choice, and steipete recently merged adjacent backup reliability work.
